source_row.rationale: Long-term nitrofurantoin use carries a rare but recognized risk of pulmonary toxicity, which can present acutely or, more classically with long-term use, as a more insidious, chronic interstitial lung process with cough and dyspnea. New respiratory symptoms in a client on long-term nitrofurantoin therapy warrant prompt evaluation and consideration of medication discontinuation.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings: Pulmonary Toxicity with Long-Term Use
